violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM during the inspection
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Suave Bar & Lounge (Inspection Date: 07/16/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM will use the 3-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize until dish machine is repair.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Observed ice machine soiled with a blackish film.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM will clean and sanitize and follow up with the Fairfax county health department in 72 hrs

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Rice, raw beef, coleslaw in unit # 1 at 68, 62, 63F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Rice, raw beef, coleslaw, and all perishable food

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Fried beans (6/29), rice (6/27)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM discarded Fried beans (6/29), rice (6/27)

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed Rice, raw beef, coleslaw, and coleslaw in unit # 2
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM discarded Rice, raw beef, coleslaws

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: container of rice and sugar needs label
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all storage containers and squeeze bottles

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Observed unit # 1 at 50F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will call technician and do not use the unit until is repaired.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level @EQUIPMENT@ is not observed. Observed no air break in the wash and rinse basin and no air gap in the sanitizer basin.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CFM will call the plumber and add the air breaks and air gap to the 3 - compartment sink

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the middle bulb on the hood is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will replace the bulb

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors in the kitchen, coolers are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. The CFM will conduct a thorough deep cleaning of the floors and all cooling equipment, including both the interior and exterior surfaces, to remove accumulated grease, food debris, and other residue. All equipment and surrounding areas shall be maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
